zh: 竞价
en: Auction

zh: 做市
en: Market making

zh: 信号是多少出多少
en: Bid the signal

zh: 把自己的估计当真：出价 = x。
en: Takes its own estimate at face value: bid = x.

zh: 保本价
en: Break-even bid

zh: 让掉赢家诅咒那一截：出价 = x − ε(N−1)/(N+1)。
en: Gives up the winner's-curse margin: bid = x − ε(N−1)/(N+1).

zh: 均衡出价
en: Equilibrium bid

zh: 所有人都这样出时，谁单独改主意都占不到便宜（Kagel–Levin 1986）。
en: When everyone bids this way, no one gains by deviating alone (Kagel–Levin 1986).

zh: 固定让价
en: Fixed shading

zh: 出价 = x − d，d 是一个固定的数。
en: Bid = x − d, where d is a fixed number.

zh: 边打边调
en: Adjust while playing

zh: 不用公式：买贵了就多让一点，很久买不到就少让一点。
en: No formula: shade more after overpaying, and shade less after a long time without winning.

zh: 固定价差
en: Fixed spread

zh: 半价差永远是 h。
en: The half-spread is always h.

zh: 保本价差
en: Break-even spread

zh: 半价差 = ε(N−1)/(N+1)：对不知情的客人刚好保本。
en: Half-spread = ε(N−1)/(N+1): exactly breaks even against uninformed customers.

zh: 保本再加一点
en: Break-even plus a margin

zh: 半价差 = ε(N−1)/(N+1) + m，多出来的 m 用来垫知情客人那一头。
en: Half-spread = ε(N−1)/(N+1) + m; the extra m covers the losses to informed customers.

zh: 边做边调
en: Adjust while quoting

zh: 成交了却亏钱就把价差放宽，很久没人成交就收窄。
en: Widens the spread after a losing trade and narrows it after a long time without trades.

zh: 全场都"信号是多少出多少"
en: Everyone bids the signal

zh: 全场都出保本价
en: Everyone bids break-even

zh: 全场都按均衡出价（信号不贴边界时的近似）
en: Everyone bids the equilibrium (approximation for signals away from the boundaries)

zh: 全场都报保本价差
en: Everyone quotes the break-even spread
